_comment: 5E powersets, structured. Authored from the legacy prose in public/templates/archtypes.json,
which stated each power as a string with a hand-typed cost ('EB 10d6', cost '5u'). Here the
costs are DERIVED: the engine prices each power from the template data, and the framework
arithmetic (multipower ultra slots /10, elemental-control discount) falls out of the
decorators. Nothing below states a cost.
Shape is a .hdc `powers` block. The KEY is the framework type — normalizeCharacterData stamps
originalType from it — and slots are siblings linked to their container by parentid.
`ultraSlot: true` makes a multipower slot cost active/10 rather than active/5.
See docs/RANDOM_CHARACTER.md. Verified against the allocator's balance in

approximations.note: Zero length/height/body/width. The legacy prose ('Force Wall 10 rPD 10 rED', 5u) gave dimensions for none of them, and any would push it past the 50 active points that 5u implies. Physically a wall with no extent — faithful to the source, but nonsense if you look at it. Give it real dimensions if the slot's cost is ever allowed to move.
